rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who gives one-to-one or small-group academic tutoring.

example.english: My tutor reviews English with me every Saturday.
example.traditional: 我個補習老師每個星期六都同我溫英文。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 bou2 zaap6 lou5 si1 mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 luk6 dou1 tung4 ngo5 wan1 jing1 man2

rows.note: Use this when you want to stress that the tutor is privately engaged rather than teaching a regular class.

example.english: We specially hired a private tutor to give me one-to-one math instruction.
example.traditional: 我哋特別聘請咗一位私人教師，為我提供一對一嘅數學指導。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 dak6 bit6 ping3 cing2 zo2 jat1 wai6 si1 jan4 gaau3 si1 wai6 ngo5 tai4 gung1 jat1 deoi3 jat1 ge3 sou3 hok6 zi2 dou6

rows.note: Use this mainly in an institutional or educational setting, where the tutor also acts as a mentor or course instructor.

example.english: My university tutor discussed my research direction with me today.
example.traditional: 大學嘅導師今日同我傾研究方向。
example.jyutping: daai6 hok6 ge3 dou6 si1 gam1 jat6 tung4 ngo5 king1 jin4 gau3 fong1 hoeng3
